evidence: Modifies ConnectBlock and script checking flow in src/validation.cpp, unifying single- and multithreaded script check execution paths through CCheckQueue.
rationale: Unifying script verification paths in ConnectBlock removes redundant inline execution logic and fixes an inconsistency where script execution cache insertion was bypassed during multithreaded TestBlockValidity.
